content.short: Chainspect helps dApp developers and crypto investors compare blockchain networks using analytics.
content.description: Chainspect is a blockchain analytics tool that enables technical comparisons of networks, helping users understand how different chains perform relative to one another. Launched in 2023, it began by tracking real-time TPS for leading networks such as Ethereum, Bitcoin, and Solana. It now covers 24 chains and provides metrics on maximum recorded TPS and block times, offering a data-driven way to assess throughput and latency across ecosystems. The service has about 700 WAUs, with a peak WAU of 1,716.
